image_title: Consolidated Financial Data - First Quarter, Fiscal 2026
summary: This table presents the consolidated statement of comprehensive income for Infosys for the three months ended June 30, 2025, and June 30, 2024, along with quarter-over-quarter comparisons for March 31, 2025. Key metrics include revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating profit, and net profit, with year-over-year growth percentages provided. Notably, revenues increased by 4.8% YoY, while net profit before non-controlling interests rose by 5.8% YoY. The operating margin remained stable at around 20.8%, indicating consistent profitability. The data highlights trends in financial performance, with a focus on growth in key areas such as operating expenses and net profit.
